species.real: Puffballs are edible while young and pure white inside, but foragers always slice them first, because a young deadly Amanita can hide in a similar egg shape.
species.name: Puffkin

dex.text: Give it a squeeze and it goes 'pff'. Give it another and so do you, coughing, in a little brown cloud.
dex.fact: A ripe puffball sends its spores out in puffs of 'smoke' whenever a raindrop or a passing foot hits it.

species.real: Dried giant puffballs were once used as tinder, as wound dressings, and by beekeepers, whose smouldering puffball smoke calmed the bees.
species.name: Grandpuff

dex.text: Has been mistaken for a stray football, a sheep and, once, at dusk, a small moon. It took all three as compliments.
dex.fact: A giant puffball can grow as big as a football, and a single one is reckoned to hold several trillion spores.
